title: Multi-Agent Reasoning Improves Compute Efficiency: Pareto-Optimal Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Florian Valentin Wunderlich、Lars Benedikt Kaesberg、Jan Philip Wahle、Terry Ruas、Bela Gipp（机构：哥廷根大学）
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展效率对比研究
best_for_zh: 需要在固定准确率、延迟或硬件预算下选择实际多智能体推理配置的读者。
one_line: This study shows that mixture-of-agents can dominate matched-budget single-agent scaling and gives concrete parallel-versus-sequential allocation rules.
该研究表明，混合智能体在等预算下可优于单智能体扩展，并给出并行与顺序计算分配的具体规则。
why: It compares scaling mechanisms at matched cost and demonstrates that the allocation of parallel agents and sequential aggregation, not only total compute, determines efficiency.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly compares how parallel and sequential inference-budget allocation changes the accuracy-time Pareto frontier for single- and multi-agent reasoning pipelines.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Inference-time methods are often reported with different, unmatched budgets. A debate system may look stronger than self-consistency only because it spends far more generations, while a FLOP-only accounting can miss memory-transfer costs that shape real accelerator latency. Practitioners therefore lack an answer to a basic deployment question: under the same budget, should they buy more independent samples, more refinement rounds, more agents, or a larger model?

This paper asks how the structure of a reasoning pipeline changes the accuracy-time frontier. It compares self-consistency, self-refinement, multi-agent debate, and mixture-of-agents rather than treating each as an isolated algorithm. The target is not maximum accuracy at unlimited cost, but Pareto-efficient configurations that either improve accuracy for a given runtime or reach a target score with less computation.

推理时方法常在不同且未对齐的预算下报告结果。辩论系统看起来可能强于自一致性，只是因为它花费了更多生成次数；而只统计浮点运算的成本又会遗漏影响实际加速器延迟的内存传输成本。因此，实践者缺少一个基本部署问题的答案：在相同预算下，应购买更多独立样本、更多反思轮次、更多智能体，还是更大的模型？

本文研究推理流水线结构如何改变准确率—时间前沿。它比较自一致性、自我反思、多智能体辩论和混合智能体，而不把每种方法当作孤立算法。目标不是在无限成本下取得最高准确率，而是寻找帕累托高效配置：在给定运行时间下提升准确率，或以更少计算达到目标分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The study treats pipeline choice, pipeline parameters, and model size as three separate levers for test-time compute. Parallel scaling means more sampled chains, debate agents, or proposer models; sequential scaling means more refinement iterations, debate rounds, or mixture layers. It then places every configuration on an accuracy-versus-estimated-runtime plot and keeps only points that are not dominated by a cheaper and more accurate alternative.

This framing exposes a practical distinction between debate and mixture-of-agents. Debate retains previous exchanges, so extra rounds enlarge the context carried by each agent and can weaken the benefit of sequential scaling. Mixture-of-agents aggregates across layers without the same accumulated dialogue history. The paper's rule of thumb is that mixture-of-agents is often Pareto efficient when the number of parallel proposer models exceeds the number of sequential layers by one.

研究把流水线选择、流水线参数和模型尺寸视为测试时计算的三种独立杠杆。并行扩展意味着更多采样思维链、辩论智能体或提议模型；顺序扩展意味着更多反思迭代、辩论轮次或混合层。随后，它把每种配置放在准确率与估计运行时间的图上，只保留那些没有被更便宜且更准确替代方案支配的点。

这一表述揭示了辩论与混合智能体之间的实际差异。辩论会保留先前交换，因此额外轮次会扩大每个智能体携带的上下文，并可能削弱顺序扩展的收益。混合智能体跨层聚合，却不会累积同样的对话历史。论文给出的经验规则是：当并行提议模型数比顺序层数多一时，混合智能体往往是帕累托高效的。

title: Method
方法
html:
The main evaluation uses Llama 3.1 70B on a shuffled sample of 1,000 MMLU-Pro questions, with BBH and Llama 3.1 8B used as robustness checks. All methods receive zero-shot reasoning prompts at temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.95. Self-consistency varies sequences, self-refinement varies revision iterations, debate varies agents and rounds, and mixture-of-agents varies proposer models and aggregation layers. The final multiple-choice answer is selected by the highest log-likelihood after a fixed answer prompt.

Across 34 configurations and more than 100 evaluations, the authors estimate runtime from both operations and model-weight memory transfer, then compute the Pareto front. They examine budgets from a single chain of thought up to roughly twenty times that compute. A difficulty analysis groups MMLU-Pro items by a 20-run chain-of-thought solve rate, allowing the study to test whether expensive scaling is most useful on tasks that the base pipeline rarely solves.

主要评测使用 Llama 3.1 70B，在随机打乱的 1,000 道 MMLU-Pro 题目上进行，并以 BBH 和 Llama 3.1 8B 作为稳健性检查。所有方法都在温度 0.7、top-p 0.95 下接受零样本推理提示。自一致性改变样本数，自我反思改变修订次数，辩论改变智能体数与轮次，混合智能体改变提议模型数与聚合层数。最终多选答案由固定答案提示后概率最高的选项确定。

在 34 种配置和超过 100 次评测中，作者从运算量和模型权重内存传输两方面估计运行时间，再计算帕累托前沿。他们考察从单条思维链到约二十倍该计算量的预算。难度分析根据 20 次思维链运行的解题率对 MMLU-Pro 题目分组，从而检验昂贵扩展是否对基础流水线很少解开的题最有价值。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On MMLU-Pro, the 70B chain-of-thought baseline scores 64.3%. At comparable high budgets, self-consistency reaches 68.7%, debate reaches 70.0%, and mixture-of-agents reaches 71.4%, a 7.1-point gain over the baseline. Relative to self-consistency under comparable compute, debate gains 1.3 points and mixture-of-agents gains 2.7 points. Self-refinement is reported below the chain-of-thought baseline despite using additional compute, showing that extra sequential work is not automatically useful.

The allocation analysis is equally important. Self-consistency saturates near ten sequences and debate near four agents, whereas mixture-of-agents continues improving through five models and four layers. For easy, medium, and hard items, increasing to 15–20 times chain-of-thought compute changes accuracy by 2.2, 8.5, and 9.0 points respectively. These curves support adaptive routing: spend high budgets principally on difficult tasks, and prefer more agents to more debate rounds when extending a debate pipeline.

在 MMLU-Pro 上，70B 思维链基线得分为 64.3%。在可比的高预算下，自一致性达到 68.7%，辩论达到 70.0%，混合智能体达到 71.4%，比基线高 7.1 个点。与可比计算量下的自一致性相比，辩论高 1.3 个点，混合智能体高 2.7 个点。论文报告，自我反思即使使用更多计算也低于思维链基线，表明额外的顺序工作并不必然有效。

计算分配分析同样重要。自一致性在接近十个样本时饱和，辩论在接近四个智能体时饱和，而混合智能体在五个模型、四层时仍持续改善。对简单、中等和困难题目，将计算提高到思维链的 15–20 倍，准确率分别变化 2.2、8.5 和 9.0 个点。这些曲线支持自适应路由：高预算主要花在困难题上；扩展辩论流水线时，应优先增加智能体而非轮次。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is the matched-cost comparison rather than the invention of a new agent architecture. Previous reports often compare a multi-agent design with only a single chain-of-thought baseline or count FLOPs without representing memory transfer. By putting four established pipelines and their parameter sweeps on one Pareto analysis, the work turns “multi-agent is better” into testable allocation claims.

It also separates parallel and sequential scaling inside each architecture. This matters because a larger nominal budget can have opposite effects depending on whether it adds independent evidence or lengthens a shared context. The rule that mixture-of-agents tends to work best with one more proposer than layers is empirical rather than universal, but it is a concrete design signal that connects an agent topology to the test-time accuracy-cost frontier.

新意在于等成本比较，而不在于发明新的智能体架构。既有报告常把多智能体设计只与单条思维链基线比较，或只统计浮点运算而不表示内存传输。通过把四种成熟流水线及其参数扫描放入同一帕累托分析，工作把“多智能体更好”转化为可检验的计算分配主张。

它还在每种架构内部区分并行与顺序扩展。这一点重要，因为更大的名义预算若增加独立证据或拉长共享上下文，可能产生相反效果。“提议模型数比层数多一时混合智能体往往最好”是一条经验规则而非普遍规律，但它是把智能体拓扑与测试时准确率—成本前沿连接起来的具体设计信号。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Runtime is estimated rather than measured end-to-end on a particular deployment stack, and the main evidence is limited to multiple-choice reasoning, two model sizes from one family, and a 1,000-item MMLU-Pro sample. Debate and mixture-of-agents implementations may behave differently with heterogeneous models, tool use, longer outputs, or alternative selection rules. The empirical ratio rule should therefore guide a configuration sweep, not replace one, and the cost of searching many pipeline settings is not itself included in the per-task frontier.
运行时间是估计值，而非在某个具体部署栈上的端到端测量；主要证据也局限于多选推理、同一模型族的两种尺寸和 1,000 个 MMLU-Pro 样本。异质模型、工具使用、更长输出或不同选择规则下，辩论与混合智能体实现可能表现不同。因此，经验比例规则应指导配置扫描，而不应取代扫描；搜索大量流水线设置的成本本身也没有计入每任务前沿。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when setting an inference budget for a reasoning service. Compare candidate pipelines at the same target latency or energy budget, record both model execution and memory movement, and choose a Pareto point rather than the maximum-score configuration. Route easy requests to a small budget, reserve multi-agent sampling for harder requests, and test whether a proposer-heavy mixture is preferable to adding more sequential aggregation or debate turns in the actual serving environment.
为推理服务设置计算预算时可以使用此卡。应在相同目标延迟或能耗预算下比较候选流水线，同时记录模型执行与内存移动，并选择帕累托点而不是最高分配置。把简单请求路由到小预算，把多智能体采样留给困难请求；并在实际服务环境中检验，以提议者为主的混合模式是否优于增加顺序聚合或辩论轮次。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The strongest result is not that every multi-agent configuration wins, but that several configurations dominate at matched estimated time. Read the Pareto plot with the parameter plots: a point can improve solely because it receives more budget, while a Pareto point shows a better allocation of that budget. The paper is most useful as an experimental-design template for a deployment-specific comparison, where measured latency and model heterogeneity should replace its hardware assumptions.
最强的结果并不是每种多智能体配置都获胜，而是在匹配的估计时间下有若干配置占优。应把帕累托图和参数图一起阅读：某一点可能仅因获得更多预算而改善，而帕累托点显示的是该预算被更好分配。此文最适合作为部署特定比较的实验设计模板，其中应以实测延迟和模型异质性替代其硬件假设。
